mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the diagonal braces was the most worthwhile step: it connected the construction to the goal and explained how the light frame holds its shape.

leastWorthwhile.text: The run of assembling and attaching parts felt predictable, with little explanation or choice once the components were prepared.

surprise.text: I was surprised that fitting the prepared braces wasn't offered until after the tail and deck were attached.

arbitrary.text: The required order of attaching the tail and deck before the braces lacked a clear structural explanation.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the flying fair comes together, although I hope the next chapter offers more meaningful choices and mechanisms to explore.
